CycloDesk: a point-and-click interface for cyclostratigraphy

Source: R/CycloDesk-package.R
CycloDesk-package.Rd

Start the interface with run_app(). The menus follow Acycle (Li et al. 2019); every calculation is done by WaverideR or astrochron, and the R code of each step is shown in the R code tab.
